question: Which Five-Year Plan's implementation was shifted to focus on the Prime Minister's 20- Point Programme during the Emergency?
solution:
The correct answer is __**1**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Fifth Five-Year Plan (1974-1979):** This plan was disrupted during the Emergency declared in 1975, and its focus was shifted towards implementing the **Prime Minister’s 20-Point Programme**.
 
• The **20-Point Programme** was launched by then Prime Minister Indira Gandhi in 1975 with the aim of alleviating poverty and improving the living standards of the poor.
